description: Use this when you need to add a part to an assembly. Durably insert `const <binding> = <assembly>.part(partName, shapeExpression, opts?)` before the final top-level return in a kernelCAD source string. Returns modified source plus diagnostics from re-evaluating it. Side-effect-free: caller persists the returned source.

assembly_binding.description: JS identifier bound to assembly(...), e.g. "arm".

binding_name.description: Optional JS const name for the returned AssemblyPartRef. Defaults to a part-name-derived identifier.

shape_expression.description: JS expression for the Shape to pass to assembly.part, inserted verbatim.

name: add_part
title: Add Part
